crossRefs.note: “Remember, now, whoever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
“Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
“Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
“Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
“You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.
“I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ when there is no peace.
Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people…
There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.
Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. You use many medicines in vain. There is no healing for you.
You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was…
“When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, Then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to king Jareb: but he is…
When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I…
and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew…

translations.web: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
translations.bsb: You, however, smear with lies; you are all worthless physicians.
translations.kjv: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
translations.asv: But ye are forgers of lies; Ye are all physicians of no value.
